channel.title: The Great Rift: Africa's Wild Heart
channel.desc: The Rift Valley channels a huge diversity of waterways - rivers, lakes, waterfalls, caustic springs and coral seas - spanning from Egypt to Mozambique. Some harbour previously unseen life-forms, while caustic waters challenge life to the extreme. Where volcanic minerals enrich the Great Rift's waterways, they provide the most spectacular concentrations of birds, mammals and fish.
